ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. High speed internet and working microphone are required for this course. There will be one half-day field trip in the Chicago area on a Saturday in June. The exact date is to be determined. Attendance is required, but, in special circumstances an alternative project may be assigned. Students who are unable to attend the field trip will be required to complete a research paper/PowerPoint presentation on an invasive species. The report will be submitted online. There is no required textbook for this course.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to MS:Nat Res & Envrn Sci -UIUC or NDEG:Grad Nondegree-CE-UIUC.
